claim: Demo actions use sample data only and never contact a messaging provider.
where: landing facts, demo banner, privacy page
sandbox: fresh browser context opened at /?demo=1; record all requests during reset, advance, assign, and resolve; assert the random demo workspace is the only data scope and every request is same-origin

claim: Every due sample reminder has delivery evidence or a staff-owned exception.
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; advance all due reminders; assert each terminal reminder has a provider delivery event or an open, assigned, or resolved exception and the displayed numerator equals the rows

claim: A sample channel without recorded consent is blocked before dispatch.
where: demo reminder timeline, how it works
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; advance the opt-out appointment; assert the channel is marked blocked, no provider-attempt event exists, and a visible exception gives the next staff action

claim: A simulated delivery failure tries the next allowed sample channel.
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; advance the provider-rejection appointment; assert the first attempt fails, the second channel matches policy order and consent, and the second attempt is labeled Simulated

claim: The sample timeline shows the channel, time, provider result, and exact outcome for each attempt.
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; open the delivered and fallback reminders; assert visible labels and accessible text contain channel, timestamp, simulated provider result, and outcome in chronological order

claim: Staff can assign and resolve a sample exception.
where: demo exception queue and reminder evidence
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; assign the unowned exception to Sam Rivera, resolve it as Called patient, reload, assert owner and resolution, then use the offered undo and assert the prior state returns

claim: Open sample exceptions stay visible until a staff member resolves them.
where: landing how-it-works step, demo ledger and exception queue
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; keep the consent-blocked exception open while advancing the failed fallback path; reload and assert it remains in the ledger and open queue; resolve it and assert it leaves the open queue but remains as resolved ledger evidence; undo and assert it returns

claim: Reset demo restores the original sample clinic.
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; change assignment, resolve one exception, advance a pending reminder, choose Reset demo, and assert the exact original seed counts and states return in a new isolated workspace

claim: Sample reminder contents exclude clinical notes, diagnoses, and treatment details.
where: landing privacy facts, demo evidence, privacy page
sandbox: fresh seeded demo; inspect every sample reminder and API response; assert only clinic name, fictional patient first name/alias, appointment date/time, location, confirmation action, and opt-out copy appear and forbidden clinical fields are absent

claim: The Clinic plan costs $79 per location each month.
sandbox: fresh public session; assert the landing and terms pages show the same exact price, billing period, and per-location unit without requiring sign-in

claim: Demo state uses an isolated HttpOnly Secure cookie that expires within 24 hours.
sandbox: fresh browser context; create a demo workspace and assert the cookie is HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, scoped to the demo API, and has Max-Age=86400

claim: Demo changes remain after navigation, reload, and repeated state reads.
sandbox: fresh demo; assign the exception, perform 30 state reads, reload the page, and assert the same workspace and owner remain; the Rust regression repeats the read through independently constructed app instances

claim: No tracking script or third-party runtime request loads.
sandbox: fresh browser context; record every request from landing through one-click demo entry and assert every URL is same-origin

claim: Visitors can follow the system theme or explicitly choose clinic daylight or after hours.
sandbox: fresh browser with a light system theme; choose after hours, reload to prove persistence, choose clinic daylight, then restore system and assert the applied theme tokens and one description meta per route

claim: JSON API writes enforce application/json and 16 KB body limits with structured errors.
sandbox: fresh client; send malformed JSON, the wrong content type, and 17 KB bodies to demo and protected billing writes; assert 400/415/413 JSON problems with unique UUID request IDs matching X-Request-Id, then assert the same correlation on 401

claim: Demo creation is limited by the ingress client address and returns Retry-After.
sandbox: fresh API client; keep the client first X-Forwarded-For hop stable while varying later proxy hops, then assert request six returns 429 JSON with Retry-After

claim: Responses use the documented browser security and immutable asset cache headers.
sandbox: fresh public session; assert CSP, HSTS, nosniff, and a one-year immutable cache policy on a hashed production asset

claim: Health reports the running build identity and metrics are machine-readable.
sandbox: fresh public session; assert health JSON contains status and build_sha and metrics returns Prometheus text

claim: A signed-in clinic owns an encrypted durable workspace; another clinic cannot read it.
where: Start for real, clinic workspace, Privacy page, README
test: cargo test --manifest-path services/api/Cargo.toml managed_claim_clinic_flow_is_authenticated_signed_durable_and_consent_aware && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:managed-auth-storage
sandbox: fixture bearer identities create and restart a workspace, post a signed calendar batch, assert another oid gets no workspace, and assert the browser exposes the exact CIAM configuration with protected APIs

claim: Reminder Proof sends individual appointment reminders and accepts no campaign copy.
test: cargo test --manifest-path services/api/Cargo.toml managed_claim_no_marketing_campaigns && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:no-marketing-campaigns
sandbox: fixture managed dispatch rejects client-supplied marketing copy, generates only the fixed appointment reminder fields, and the browser confirms no campaign or bulk-marketing action is exposed

claim: A signed-in clinic can export its own workspace and delete it only with its organization confirmation.
test: cargo test --manifest-path services/api/Cargo.toml managed_claim_export_and_delete_are_owner_scoped && npm run test:e2e -- --grep @claim:signed-in-export-delete
sandbox: fixture bearer owner exports a minimized attachment, another oid cannot read it, incorrect deletion confirmation preserves it, correct organization confirmation deletes it, and anonymous browser requests remain protected

claim: A rejected approved channel tries the next consented provider and a signed receipt records delivery.
where: Start for real, clinic workspace, README
sandbox: a fixture HTTP SMS provider rejects, fixture email accepts, the persisted timeline records both outcomes in order, and a receipt changes the reminder to delivered

claim: Clinic checkout is hosted by Sociobot and a valid return activates the clinic subscription.
where: Start for real, clinic workspace, README
sandbox: a fixture Sociobot checkout responds with a redirect, the same-origin route returns only that URL, and its fixture verification response activates the saved subscription

claim: Every saved clinic change has a durable matching key and a 30-day recovery pair.
sandbox: fresh temporary store; save a clinic workspace, assert the matching durable database/key and daily pair exist, prune an over-30-day pair, remove the local database/key, and assert startup restores the workspace

claim: Production configuration uses one replica and mounts separate durable and backup shares.
sandbox: read the checked-in deployment configuration and assert one min/max replica plus the two Azure Files volume names, storage bindings, and mount paths
